question: What is the state of the art system mentioned?

answer.free_form_answer:
Two knowledge-based systems,
two traditional word expert supervised systems, six recent neural-based systems, and one BERT feature-based system.

title: GlossBERT: BERT for Word Sense Disambiguation with Gloss Knowledge
answer_short: BERT-based models fine-tuned on context-gloss pairs
answer_rationale: The document states that the proposed system constructs context-gloss pairs and fine-tunes the pre-trained BERT model, achieving new state-of-the-art results on WSD. This is explicitly mentioned in Text 1 and Text 2, and further elaborated in Text 9 and Text 11.
